meals.recipe_name: Loaded Spinach & Cheddar Scramble with Toast
recipe_steps: Crack 3 whole eggs into a bowl, add 1/2 cup egg whites, 1/4 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp black pepper. Whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until uniform and slightly frothy.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat (about 300°F). Add 1 tsp olive oil and 1 cup spinach; sauté 1-2 minutes until just wilted, then push to one side.
Add 1 tbsp butter to the pan and let it melt fully, swirling to coat.
Pour in the eggs. Let them sit 20 seconds, then use a silicone spatula to gently push curds from the edges to the center, tilting the pan so raw egg flows underneath. Repeat for about 2 minutes.
When eggs are 80% set but still glossy, sprinkle 1/3 cup shredded cheddar over the top and fold spinach through. Turn off heat; residual heat finishes cooking in 30 seconds.
Meanwhile, toast 2 slices of homemade sandwich bread until golden, about 2 minutes.
Slide the scramble onto a plate alongside the toast and serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: In a large bowl combine 3 1/2 cups bread flour, 2 tsp instant yeast, 2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar. Add 1 1/4 cups warm water (105°F) and 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix to a shaggy dough, then knead 10 min until smooth. Cover and proof 1 hr until doubled. Punch down, shape into a loaf, place in a greased 9x5 pan, proof 45 min. Bake at 375°F for 35 min until internal temp is 200°F. Cool fully, slice, store in airtight bag; this loaf serves multiple breakfasts through the week.

recipe_steps: Cut 8 oz chicken breast into 3/4-inch cubes and pat dry.
Whisk sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1.5 tbsp honey, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1 tsp sesame oil, and 2 tbsp water.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high (400°F). Add chicken in a single layer; sear undisturbed 3 min, then stir and cook 3-4 min more until browned and 165°F internal.
Add broccoli and 2 tbsp water; cover 2 min to steam-crisp.
Pour in sauce; simmer 1-2 min, stirring, until it thickens and glazes the chicken.
Serve over 1.5 cups warm rice. Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night to fully thaw for Monday lunch. If forgotten, cold-water thaw in a sealed bag Monday morning, ~40 min, changing water every 30 min.

Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice until water runs clear. Combine with 3 cups water in a pot, bring to boil, cover, reduce to low, cook 15 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate; portion across the week's rice-based meals.

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Garlic Butter Quinoa
recipe_steps: Rinse 3/4 cup quinoa; combine with 1.5 cups water and a pinch of salt. Boil, cover, simmer 15 min until water absorbs. Fluff with a fork.
Pat salmon dry and season both sides with 1/4 tsp salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400°F). Place salmon skin-side down; sear 4 min without moving until skin is crisp.
Flip, reduce to medium, cook 3 more min until internal temp reaches 125°F for medium. Remove to a plate.
Lower heat, add 1.5 tbsp butter and 2 minced garlic cloves; cook 45 sec until fragrant. Add asparagus and remaining salt; sauté 3-4 min until tender-crisp.
Stir the cooked quinoa into the garlic butter. Squeeze lemon over salmon and plate everything together.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner. Alternatively cold-water thaw sealed Monday afternoon, ~30 min.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup mixed berries, 1/4 cup granola, and 2 tbsp chopped almonds.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and serve immediately.
Add 1 cup whole milk, 1 banana, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1/4 cup rolled oats, and 1/2 cup ice to a blender.
Blend on high 45-60 sec until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.
Blend 1/2 cup cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup oats, 1/2 scoop whey, and 1/2 tsp baking powder into a smooth batter, about 30 sec.
Let batter rest 5 min to thicken.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low (300°F) and melt 1 tbsp butter.
Pour 1/4-cup portions to form 3-4 pancakes. Cook 2-3 min until bubbles form and edges set, then flip and cook 1-2 min more until golden.
Stack on a plate, top with 1/2 cup berries and 2 tbsp maple syrup. Serve hot.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey & Avocado Wrap with Sweet Potato Fries
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut sweet potato into 1/4-inch fries, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt. Spread on a sheet and roast 25 min, flipping halfway.
Heat 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add 6 oz ground turkey, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp salt. Cook 6-7 min, breaking up, until browned and 165°F.
Warm the flour tortilla in a dry pan 20 sec per side.
Lay tortilla flat; layer 1 cup lettuce, sliced tomato, sliced avocado, and the turkey.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly into a wrap. Slice in half and serve with the sweet potato fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday lunch. If needed, cold-water thaw sealed Tuesday morning, ~30 min.

Mix 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tbsp olive oil, and 3/4 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 5 min, rest covered 30 min. Divide into 6 balls, roll each thin, cook in a dry skillet over medium-high 45 sec per side until puffed and spotted. Store in an airtight bag for the week's wraps.

meals.recipe_name: Beef Stir-Fry with Peppers over Rice
recipe_steps: Slice flank steak thinly against the grain. Toss with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce; rest 10 min.
Mix sauce: 1.5 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp water.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat until smoking. Sear steak in a single layer 1-2 min per side until browned; remove.
Add 1/2 tbsp oil, then sliced pepper and onion; stir-fry 3 min until crisp-tender. Add garlic, cook 30 sec.
Return beef, pour in sauce, toss 1 min until glossy and coated.
Serve over 1.5 cups warm rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner. Cold-water thaw sealed Tuesday afternoon ~40 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Drain the can of tuna and flake into a bowl.
Mix in 1 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tsp lemon juice, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Halve cucumber lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a spoon to form boats.
Fill the cucumber halves with the tuna salad and serve.
Retrieve the jar of overnight oats from the fridge.
Stir well, top with 2 tbsp chopped almonds and drizzle 1 tbsp honey.
Eat cold.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday night combine 1/2 cup rolled oats, 2/3 cup whole milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, and 1 tsp chia seeds in a jar. Stir, cover, refrigerate overnight for Tuesday.

recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium. Add diced onion and pepper; cook 5 min until soft.
Add garlic, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp paprika; stir 30 sec.
Pour in 1 cup crushed tomatoes, season with salt. Simmer 5 min until thickened.
Make 3 wells with a spoon and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 5-6 min until whites set but yolks are runny.
Crumble 1/4 cup feta over the top. Toast 2 slices of bread and serve alongside for dipping.
Heat 1/2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Beat 2 eggs; scramble briefly until just set, remove.
Add 1/2 tbsp oil, then shrimp; cook 2-3 min until pink and opaque. Remove.
Add remaining 1/2 tbsp oil, garlic, and peas/carrots; stir-fry 2 min.
Add 1.5 cups cold cooked rice, breaking up clumps, and fry 3-4 min pressing against the wok to crisp.
Return eggs and shrimp, add 2.5 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil; toss 1 min.
Finish with sliced green onions and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch. Or cold-water thaw sealed Wednesday morning, ~15 min.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Chops with Apple Slaw & Mashed Potatoes
recipe_steps: Peel and cube potato; boil in salted water 15 min until fork-tender. Drain, mash with 1 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup milk, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Make slaw: toss 1.5 cups shredded cabbage and matchstick apple with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, and a pinch of salt.
Pat pork chop dry, season both sides with 1/2 tsp salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400°F). Sear chop 4 min undisturbed until crusted.
Flip, add 1 tbsp butter, and baste 3-4 min, spooning butter over, until internal temp reaches 145°F. Rest 5 min.
Plate the chop with mashed potatoes and apple slaw.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork chop from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner. Cold-water thaw sealed Wednesday afternoon ~40 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and 2 tbsp chopped walnuts.
Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve.
Add 1 cup milk, 1 cup berries, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 1/2 cup ice to a blender.
Blend on high 45 sec until smooth.
Pour and drink immediately.
Whisk 3 eggs with 1/4 tsp black pepper.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low (300°F), melt 1 tbsp butter.
Pour in eggs; stir gently 2 min into soft curds.
When 80% set, fold in 2 tbsp cream cheese in small dabs and flaked smoked salmon; cook 30 sec more.
Toast 2 slices of bread. Plate eggs, sprinkle with chopped chives, and serve with toast.
Season 7 oz chicken breast with 1/2 tsp garlic powder and 1/4 tsp salt.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 5-6 min per side until 165°F internal. Rest 5 min, then slice.
Toss 2 cups chopped romaine with 2 tbsp Caesar dressing and 3 tbsp parmesan.
Warm the tortilla 20 sec per side. Fill with salad and sliced chicken.
Roll tightly, slice in half, and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch. Cold-water thaw sealed Thursday morning ~40 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut potato into fries, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt, roast 25 min flipping halfway.
Form 7 oz bison into a patty, season both sides with 1/2 tsp salt and pepper.
Heat 1/2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high (400°F). Cook patty 3-4 min per side until 150°F, adding cheddar slice in last minute to melt.
Toast the bun cut-side down in the pan 1 min.
Build the burger with lettuce, tomato, onion, and patty. Serve with fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner. Cold-water thaw sealed Thursday afternoon ~30 min if needed.

Mix 3 cups bread flour, 1 packet (2 1/4 tsp) instant yeast, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 egg, 1 cup warm milk, and 3 tbsp softened butter. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr until doubled. Divide into 6, shape into balls, proof 45 min. Brush with egg wash, bake at 375°F for 15 min until golden. Freeze extras; thaw at room temp the morning of use.

recipe_steps: Boil eggs: place in cold water, bring to boil, cover, turn off heat, let sit 11 min. Cool in ice water and peel.
Slice carrots into sticks.
Serve eggs sprinkled with salt alongside 1/4 cup hummus and carrot sticks.
Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1/2 cup ice to a blender.
Blend on high 45 sec until smooth.
Pour and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Savory Oatmeal with Fried Egg & Avocado
recipe_steps: Bring 1.5 cups chicken broth to a boil. Add 3/4 cup oats and 1/4 tsp salt; simmer 5 min until creamy.
Stir 1/4 cup cheddar into the oats.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium; fry 2 eggs 3 min until whites set and yolks runny.
Spoon oats into a bowl, top with fried eggs, sliced avocado, and green onion. Serve hot.
Drain tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil.
Mix spicy mayo: 1 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp sriracha.
Warm 1.5 cups rice and spread in a bowl.
Top with the tuna, sliced avocado, and diced cucumber.
Drizzle spicy mayo, sprinkle sesame seeds and green onion. Serve.
Boil linguine in salted water per package (about 9 min). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, drain.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high. Add shrimp, cook 2 min per side until pink; remove.
Add remaining 1 tbsp butter, garlic, and 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes; cook 45 sec. Add halved cherry tomatoes, cook 2 min.
Return shrimp, add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water; toss to coat.
Off heat, stir in parmesan, lemon juice, and parsley. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner. Or cold-water thaw sealed Friday afternoon ~15 min.

recipe_steps: Layer half the yogurt in a glass, then half the granola and walnuts.
Repeat with remaining yogurt, granola, and walnuts.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey and serve.
Lay out turkey slices, spread lightly with mustard.
Place a strip of cheddar on each and roll up tightly.
Serve with whole grain crackers.
Dice potato small. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high; add potato, diced onion, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp salt. Cook 10-12 min, stirring, until crisp and golden.
Season steak with 1/4 tsp salt and pepper. In another pan heat 1/2 tbsp oil over high; sear steak 3 min per side to 130°F. Rest 5 min, slice thin.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in the pan and fry 3 eggs to preference, about 3 min.
Plate home fries, sliced steak, and eggs together. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday breakfast. Cold-water thaw sealed Saturday morning ~30 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Slice pork loin thin; marinate 5 min in 1.5 tbsp soy sauce, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp sesame oil.
Sauté carrot matchsticks 2 min in a lightly oiled pan; remove. Wilt spinach with remaining garlic 1 min; remove.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil over high; cook pork 4-5 min until caramelized and 145°F.
Fry 1 egg sunny-side up, about 3 min.
Assemble bowl: 1.5 cups rice topped with pork, carrots, spinach, and fried egg. Add 1 tbsp gochujang and 1/2 tsp sesame oil. Mix and eat.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz pork loin from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch. Cold-water thaw sealed Saturday morning ~40 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken thighs dry, rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, minced garlic, 1/2 tsp salt.
Place thighs skin-up on a sheet with halved cherry tomatoes and sliced zucchini tossed in 1 tbsp oil and 1/4 tsp salt.
Roast 25-28 min until chicken reaches 175°F and skin is crisp.
Meanwhile bring 1 cup chicken broth to a boil, stir in 3/4 cup couscous, cover, remove from heat, rest 5 min. Fluff.
Plate couscous with chicken and roasted veg; squeeze lemon over the top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz bone-in chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner. Cold-water thaw sealed Saturday afternoon ~45 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices of bread until golden.
Spread 3/4 cup cottage cheese over the toast.
Top with sliced tomato, drizzle 1 tsp olive oil, and crack black pepper over. Serve.
Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1/3 cup oats, 1 banana, 1 tbsp almonds, and 1/2 cup ice to a blender.
Blend on high 60 sec until smooth.
Pour and drink immediately.
Mix 5 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp fennel seed, 1/2 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp salt to make sausage.
Heat 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high; cook turkey sausage 6 min, breaking up, until browned and 165°F. Add diced pepper in last 2 min. Remove.
Whisk 3 eggs with 1/4 tsp salt. In the same pan with 1/2 tbsp oil, scramble over medium-low 2 min until soft-set.
Warm tortilla 20 sec per side. Fill with eggs, turkey sausage, and 1/3 cup cheddar.
Fold in sides and roll into a burrito. Sear seam-side down in the pan 1 min to seal. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday breakfast. Cold-water thaw sealed Sunday morning ~25 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Mix 1/2 cup cornmeal, 1/3 cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, pinch salt with 1 egg, 1/3 cup milk, 1 tbsp oil. Pour into a greased small pan; bake 18 min until golden.
Heat a pot over medium-high; brown 7 oz ground beef 5 min. Add diced onion, cook 3 min.
Stir in 1 tbsp chili powder and 1 tsp cumin; cook 30 sec.
Add 1 cup crushed tomatoes and 3/4 cup drained kidney beans. Simmer 12 min until thickened.
Serve chili hot with a square of fresh cornbread.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch. Cold-water thaw sealed Sunday morning ~30 min if needed.

meals.recipe_name: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sesame Greens & Rice
recipe_steps: Preheat broiler to high. Whisk glaze: 1.5 tbsp miso, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp rice vinegar.
Place salmon on a foil-lined tray, brush with glaze. Broil 6-8 min until caramelized and internal temp 125°F.
Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a pan over medium-high; add garlic and bok choy, stir-fry 3-4 min until tender-crisp.
Serve salmon over 1.5 cups warm rice with the greens. Sprinkle sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner. Cold-water thaw sealed Sunday afternoon ~30 min if needed.

recipe_steps: Whisk 1 cup Greek yogurt with 1/2 scoop chocolate whey, 1 tsp cocoa powder, and 1 tbsp honey until smooth and fluffy.
Spoon into a bowl and top with 2 tbsp chopped walnuts.
Serve chilled.
Melt 1 tsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low; scramble 2 eggs 2 min until just set.
Warm the tortilla 20 sec per side.
Fill with eggs, 1/4 cup cheddar, and 2 tbsp salsa. Roll up and serve.
